youtube_description:
January 22/2019
Today I am Brown-Lowery Provincial Park. This is a small park located 49 kilometers Southwest of Calgary, Alberta.  I will be hiking the Perimeter loop which is 6.6 kilometers, and has an elevation gain of 229 meters.  There are 3 loop trails here to choose from.  The Wild Rose loop is 4.8 kilometers and the Old Mill loop is 6.3 kilometers.  This is a beautiful little park, with views of the Rocky Mountains, and is a great spot to hike with your family and pets, close to Calgary.  

This is my 25th video.  Thank you very much for watching.  If you enjoyed this video please give it a thumbs up.  If you would like to see my other videos, Subscribe to my channel.  New videos weekly.  CHEERS
Thank you, 
Cary Mason
